excerpt: The HHL box gives O((log N)^2) quantum steps to output |x>, while warning that full recovery of the vector, data input, matrix sparsity, and condition number constrain the advantage.
overview: The HHL discussion captures both the appeal and the fragility of exponential speedup claims. The evidence supports the conditional nature of quantum linear-system advantages: the output is a quantum state and many useful classical answers require additional extraction work.
title: HHL Runtime Caveats
